# Figure plan (generated by tools/design_docs.py from figure_plan.py; do not edit by hand)

MODEL v2.1.1 (design: [FIGURE_PLAN_v2.md](FIGURE_PLAN_v2.md), amended by the v2.1.0 and v2.1.1 entries; sensitivity rows: [SENSITIVITY_PLAN.md](SENSITIVITY_PLAN.md)). Four sets. **Paper** (`outputs/paper/`): Fig1-Fig6 at Nature widths (183 mm double, 89 mm single column), PNG 300 dpi (with `run_all.py --export` also vector PDF and source-data CSV), Tables 1-2, with `PAPER.md` (findings, every figure with its caption, the tables). **Extended Data** (`outputs/extended_data/`): ED1-ED13, same formats, with `EXTENDED_DATA.md`. **Key figures** (`outputs/key_figures/`): K1-K6, same formats, with `KEY_FIGURES.md`. **Diagnostics** (`outputs/diagnostics/<group>/`): every other figure, PNG 300 dpi, indexed in `DIAGNOSTICS.md`. All figures use `style.py` (docs/PALETTE.md) and the vocabulary of `naming.py` (docs/RENAMING.md). Caption numbers are read from the data files when the figure is drawn. Maintenance (B2, B4) is drawn as its own layer only in Fig3_reference_carbon, Fig5_pathways, D25_annual_carbon_by_band, D26_cumulative_carbon_by_band, D32_tl_staircase, K2_reference_carbon, K5_band_waterfall (figure audit; tests/test_release.py). Every planetary-boundary figure uses the boundary styling of `style.py` (thin AR and AtP lines; zones below AtP, between AtP and AR and above AR): Fig4_reference_boundaries, Fig5_pathways, Fig6_emissions_solution_space, ED5_monte_carlo, ED6_ambitious_settings, ED7_rollout_timing, ED10_replacement_variants, ED11_mc_scatter, ED13_conditional_tl, D21_fan_and_boundaries, D22_boundaries, D23_annual_loe, D24_headroom, D25_annual_carbon_by_band, D26_cumulative_carbon_by_band, D27_variants_vs_boundaries, D28_pathways_annual, D32_tl_staircase, D34_tl_dwellings, K3_annual_emissions, K4_solution_space, K5_band_waterfall.

## Paper

### Fig1. How the model works

* File: `outputs/paper/Fig1_model_schematic.png` / `.pdf` / `.csv` (183 mm)
* Panels: one panel: population -> households -> dwellings required -> floor area -> embodied carbon -> level of exceedance against the AESA boundaries (AR, AtP); the demand bands branch off the dwellings step, each lever (L1-L9) attached to the band or quantity it acts on; P1-P4 group the levers, P5 combines them; TL1-TL10 at the end of the same arrows; the untargeted band (population growth) marked
* Data: naming.py, levers.py (structure only; no numbers)
* Draft caption: Model structure. A bottom-up chain converts population and household projections into dwellings required, floor area by reason for building (demand bands) and embodied carbon, which is compared with two allocations of a global carrying capacity (acquired rights, AR; ability to pay, AtP). Pathway levers act on the band or quantity they target; only population growth is untargeted by design.
* Replaces (model-v1.1.0): H1; (v3.1): new

### Fig2. Why floor area is built

* File: `outputs/paper/Fig2_floor_area_bands.png` / `.pdf` / `.csv` (183 mm)
* Panels: floor area by demand band: history one column per census interval with the census-measured net replacement and the unexplained building (faded red; may be negative), the observed annual floor area built as a thin line over the history columns (caption only, not in the legend), Reference projection annual 2026-2050
* Data: data/baseline/bands_history.csv, data/baseline/bands_history_replacement_split.csv, data/baseline/bands_annual.csv, data/baseline/annual.csv
* Draft caption: Floor area by reason for building. Bands sum to the in-scope total. Only population growth is untargeted; smaller households, extra space, vacancy, the 2026 overbuild, historical replacement and the recent replacement surge are the bands the pathways act on.
* Replaces (model-v1.1.0): H3; (v3.1): diag_4_floor_area, boss_04_annual_gfa, Fig2_demand_bands (a)

### Fig3. Embodied carbon of the Reference

* File: `outputs/paper/Fig3_reference_carbon.png` / `.pdf` / `.csv` (183 mm)
* Panels: 1 x 3 panels, shared y axis, annual 2026-2050, stacked (kt CO2e): (a) by demand band, (b) by life-cycle stage (A1-A3, A4-A5, maintenance B2/B4, soil carbon loss), (c) by material; no committed carbon; one compact legend per panel
* Data: data/baseline/bands_annual.csv, data/baseline/annual_by_stage.csv, data/baseline/annual_by_material.csv
* Draft caption: Embodied carbon of new residential construction in the Reference, per year. Materials (A1-A3), construction (A4-A5) and soil carbon loss are counted in the construction year, maintenance (B2, B4) in the year it occurs within 2026-2050.
* Replaces (model-v1.1.0): H4; (v3.1): boss_05_annual_carbon, boss_10_material_flows, diag_5_carbon, Fig2_demand_bands (b), Fig3_reference_carbon (a, b)

### Fig4. The Reference against the boundaries

* File: `outputs/paper/Fig4_reference_boundaries.png` / `.pdf` / `.csv` (183 mm)
* Panels: (a) annual Reference carbon with its Monte Carlo 5-95% band, the thin history line joined to the projection, the annual AR and AtP boundaries with the zones; (b) cumulative column: Reference carbon 2026-2050 with its Monte Carlo whisker and the emissions committed after 2050 stacked above it (hatched, no whisker; accounting range as text), the cumulative AR and AtP budgets over the 2026-2050 column only, LoE AR and AtP labelled
* Data: data/pathways/annual.csv, data/pathways/montecarlo_annual.csv, data/pathways/montecarlo_summary.csv, data/pathways/runs.csv, data/aesa/annual.csv, data/aesa/results.json
* Draft caption: Absolute sustainability of the Reference.
* Replaces (model-v1.1.0): H5, H6; (v3.1): pb_2_loe, pb_6_committed, Fig3_reference_carbon (c), Fig5_boundaries_attribution (a)

### Fig5. What the pathways and the theoretical limit remove

* File: `outputs/paper/Fig5_pathways.png` / `.pdf` / `.csv` (183 mm)
* Panels: (a) cumulative carbon 2026-2050 by demand band and (b) by life-cycle stage, for the Reference, P1-P5 (Moderate) and TL, with the cumulative AR and AtP budgets and the boundary zones; net-total convention for negative bands; (c) full width: the band waterfall (as K5; TL timing one step; dotted line between the pathways and the theoretical limit; segments by demand band; cumulative budgets)
* Data: data/pathways/bands.csv, data/pathways/runs.csv, data/pathways/waterfall_sequential.csv, data/pathways/theoretical_limit.json
* Draft caption: Pathways by demand band and life-cycle stage, and the sequential path to the theoretical limit. TL: hyper-optimistic theoretical limit; a thought experiment, not a pathway; every lever at its limit, adopted by 2030.
* Replaces (model-v1.1.0): H7, H9; (v3.1): pw_1_bands_by_pathway, pw_2_shapley_waterfall, pw_8_staircase, Fig4_pathways_bands, Fig5_boundaries_attribution (b), K5_band_waterfall

### Fig6. Emissions and the solution space

* File: `outputs/paper/Fig6_emissions_solution_space.png` / `.pdf` / `.csv` (183 mm)
* Panels: (a) annual emissions 2026-2050, linear axis: the Reference, P5 (Moderate) and TL, each with its Monte Carlo 5-95% band, the annual boundaries; (b) the solution space (as K4): P1-P5 Moderate filled, Ambitious hollow, TL a larger deep-green circle
* Data: data/pathways/annual.csv, data/pathways/montecarlo_annual.csv, data/pathways/montecarlo_summary.csv, data/pathways/solution_space.csv, data/pathways/backcast.json, data/pathways/theoretical_limit.json
* Draft caption: Annual emissions of the Reference, P5 Combined and the theoretical limit, and the solution space (after Horup et al. 2025, Fig. 6). Markers sit at each run's effective reductions of 2027-2050 floor area and non-soil carbon per m2; L8, L9, TL8 and TL9 also lower soil carbon, which the plane does not show. TL: hyper-optimistic theoretical limit; a thought experiment, not a pathway; every lever at its limit, adopted by 2030.
* Replaces (model-v1.1.0): H8, H10; (v3.1): pw_3_solution_space, pw_4_annual_SI, Fig5_boundaries_attribution (a), Fig6_solution_space

## Decisions of model-v1.0.0 (historical; figure ids of that release)

* **H11 (now ED1 / ED4), population rows: option A.** The population 5th / 95th rows change the AR boundary as well: their LoE is computed on each population path with the exact engine carbon of that path.
* **H10 (now Fig6), TL marker: yes**, at its effective coordinates, with the caveat that TL5 and TL6 lower soil carbon, which the plane does not show.
* **H4 (now Fig3), annual components: yes**, an exact decomposition of the annual carbon.
